tools.name: find_projects
tools.description: Finds crypto projects whose name or symbol contains the query, largest TVL first, with slug, category, TVL and market cap. Includes blockchains' own projects (flagged `is_chain`: true; use chain_metrics for the chain, project_metrics for its coin). Use the slug with the other project tools. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

query.description: Part of a project's name or symbol.

tools.name: project_metrics
tools.description: A crypto project's current metrics from AlphaGrowth: TVL, price, market cap, volume, revenue, users and social followers with 1d/7d/30d changes, plus its description, categories, chains and links. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

slug.description: The project's slug, name or ticker (e.g. uniswap, Uniswap, UNI); find_projects lists them.

tools.name: project_tvl_history
tools.description: A crypto project's total value locked per day (USD, with its staking part) for up to 3650 days, and its TVL on each chain it runs on: the latest value and share, plus one point per day (at most 365 days back) with chain_history=yes. Chain projects carry their chain's TVL and no chain split. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

chain_history.description: yes to add each chain's daily series over the same days.

days.description: Days of daily history, counting today.

slug.description: The project's slug, name or ticker (e.g. uniswap, Uniswap, UNI); find_projects lists them.

tools.name: forks
tools.description: A protocol's forks: the protocols it forked its code from, and the live protocols that fork it ranked by TVL (USD), with the forks' count and combined TVL, 50 per page. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

slug.description: The project's slug; find it with find_projects.

tools.name: project_community
tools.description: How fast a crypto project's community is growing: followers or members per network (X/Twitter, Telegram, Discord, Reddit) with 1d/7d/30d percent changes and one point per day for up to 90 days. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

days.description: Days of daily history, counting today.

network.description: Only this network; all four when omitted.

slug.description: The project's slug, name or ticker (e.g. uniswap, Uniswap, UNI); find_projects lists them.

tools.name: rank_projects
tools.description: Ranks crypto projects by a metric such as TVL, market cap, price, revenue or followers (or its 1d/7d/30d change), optionally within a category or chain, 50 per page. Sub-projects such as Aave V2 and Aave V3 rank as their own rows beside their parent. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

category.description: Only projects in this category: its slug or name (e.g. dexs, Dexs).

chain.description: Only projects on this chain: the `chain_slug` of a row from the chains tool, or the chain's name or ticker (e.g. eth, Ethereum).

sort_order.description: desc for the highest first, asc for the lowest.

tools.name: categories
tools.description: Crypto project categories (DEXs, lending, RWA, gaming, ...) with their slugs, most projects first, 50 per page; top-level categories also carry their projects' combined TVL, market cap and 30d changes. Use a slug as the category filter of rank_projects, recent_funding_rounds and upcoming_projects. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

query.description: Only categories whose name or slug contains this text.

tools.name: upcoming_projects
tools.description: New crypto projects by launch date, 50 per page: launching in the next 90 days (soonest first) or launched in the last 30 (newest first), with categories, website, a short description and price, market cap and TVL where known. Filter by category slug (see categories). Token generation events are in upcoming_tges. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

category.description: Only projects in this category: its slug or name (e.g. dexs, Dexs).

status.description: launching: the next 90 days; launched: the last 30 days.

tools.name: upcoming_tges
tools.description: Upcoming token generation events (TGEs), soonest first, 50 per page: the date and the project with its categories, website and a short description. Optionally only the next `days` days. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

days.description: Only TGEs within this many days from today.

tools.name: project_funding
tools.description: A crypto project's funding rounds (oldest first, with date, amount, type and valuation where known), the investors behind them and the total raised. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

slug.description: The project's slug, name or ticker (e.g. uniswap, Uniswap, UNI); find_projects lists them.

tools.name: recent_funding_rounds
tools.description: The most recent crypto funding rounds, newest first, with project, category, amount, type and investors, optionally within a category, 50 per page. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

category.description: Only rounds of projects in this category: its slug or name (e.g. dexs, Dexs).

tools.name: top_investors
tools.description: The top 100 crypto investors ranked by number of projects funded or by total amount invested, with their first 20 funded projects (projects_more counts the rest), 50 per page. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

sort_by.description: projects ranks by projects funded, amount by USD invested.

tools.name: investor_profile
tools.description: A crypto investor's public profile (type, location, website, industries, investment criteria) and its investments, newest first, 50 per page. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

page.description: Page number of the investments, 50 per page.

slug.description: The investor's slug or name (e.g. polychain-capital, Polychain Capital); top_investors and recent_funding_rounds list them.

tools.name: chains
tools.description: Blockchains ranked by TVL with price, market cap, 1d/7d TVL change and how many projects run on each, 50 per page. Use a chain's slug with chain_metrics, project_tvl_history (its daily TVL since launch) and chain_fees, and its chain_slug as the chain filter of rank_projects. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

query.description: Only chains whose name contains this text.

tools.name: chain_metrics
tools.description: A blockchain's metrics as on AlphaGrowth's chain compare page. Every value (TVL, transactions, price, social numbers) is for `date`, one day ago (UTC), not the current value; the ecosystem counts (projects, dapps, games, markets, pools) are current. The chain's current price and market metrics are in project_metrics with the same slug, its daily TVL history in project_tvl_history and the fees earned on it in chain_fees. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

slug.description: The chain's slug, name or ticker (e.g. ethereum, Ethereum, ETH), as chains lists it.

tools.name: fees
tools.description: Protocols ranked by fees or revenue for the latest completed day, with the 24h change, the chains they earn on and their version splits, 50 per page. The 7d fields are real sums of the last seven days including the latest one. The 24h changes are null when the day before had no value. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

sort_order.description: desc for the highest first, asc for the lowest.

tools.name: fees_history
tools.description: A protocol's fees and revenue per day (USD) for up to 3650 days, with the period's totals and its fees on each chain on the latest day; chain_history=yes adds each chain's daily series. Version-split parents (Uniswap) carry no chain split: ask for a version (uniswap-v3). fees ranks protocols by the latest day. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

chain_history.description: yes to add each chain's daily series over the same days.

days.description: Days of daily history, counting today.

slug.description: The project's slug; find it with find_projects or fees.

tools.name: chain_fees
tools.description: Protocols ranked by the fees or revenue they earned on one chain on the latest completed day (USD), 50 per page. The chain is a slug from chains. fees ranks across all chains; fees_history gives one protocol's days. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

chain.description: The chain's slug, as listed by chains.

sort_by.description: fees or revenue, earned on the chain.

sort_order.description: desc for the highest first, asc for the lowest.

tools.name: volumes
tools.description: Protocols ranked by trading volume, updated daily: kind dexs (spot DEX volume), options (options notional) or aggregators (DEX aggregator volume). Per protocol the 24h, 7d, 30d and 1y volume, the 1d/7d/30d change, its chains and category, with totals over the selection, 50 per page. With chain, each protocol's volume on that chain is chain_volume_24h_usd and the ranking and 24h total are that chain's (no 7d or 30d total). Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

category.description: A DefiLlama category, case-insensitive (Dexs, Derivatives, DEXAggregator, Options).

chain.description: A chain, by DefiLlama's chain key or name, case-insensitive (ethereum, base, arbitrum, bsc, solana, avax, hyperliquid).

sort_order.description: desc for the highest first, asc for the lowest.

tools.name: volume_history
tools.description: A protocol's trading volume per day (USD) for up to 3650 days: kind dexs (spot DEX volume), options (options notional) or aggregators. The slug is a module from volumes (uniswap-v3) or an AlphaGrowth project slug. Gives the period's total and the latest day's volume on each chain; chain_history=yes adds each chain's daily series. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

chain_history.description: yes to add each chain's daily series over the same days.

days.description: Days of daily history, counting today.

slug.description: The protocol's module as volumes lists it, or its project slug.

tools.name: token_prices
tools.description: Current USD prices of up to 30 tokens, with market cap, 24h volume and 24h change. Name each token as coingecko:<id> (coingecko:bitcoin), <chain>:<contract address> (ethereum:0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, solana:EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v, base:0x...) or a bare CoinGecko id. Tokens without a price are listed in not_found; vault, LP and other tokens without a CoinGecko coin have a price but no market cap or volume. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tokens.description: Comma-separated tokens: coingecko:<id>, <chain>:<address> or a CoinGecko id.

tools.name: token_price_history
tools.description: A coin's USD price, market cap and 24h volume per day (up to 365 days back) or per hour (up to 90 days back), oldest first, by CoinGecko id (bitcoin, ethereum, usd-coin). Each point is the last sample in its day or hour, at the bucket's start. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

days.description: How many days back, 1 to 365 (1 to 90 for interval hour).

tools.name: stablecoins
tools.description: Stablecoins ranked by circulating supply in USD, updated daily: per stablecoin its peg type and mechanism, price, supply now and a day, a week and a month ago (in peg units), the 1d/7d/30d change and its largest chains, with the total over the selection, 50 per page. With chain, the supply, ranking and total are that chain's (stablecoin_chains ranks the chains). Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

chain.description: A chain name as DefiLlama writes it, case-insensitive (Ethereum, Tron, Base, BSC, Solana).

peg_type.description: A peg, case-insensitive (peggedUSD, peggedEUR, peggedVAR for floating).

tools.name: stablecoin_chains
tools.description: Chains ranked by the stablecoins circulating on them, in USD, updated daily: per chain the total, how many stablecoins and the largest one with its share, 50 per page. stablecoins with chain lists one chain's stablecoins. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tools.name: stablecoin_history
tools.description: Stablecoin supply per day for up to 3650 days. With stablecoin (a symbol such as USDT, a CoinGecko id or DefiLlama's id): its supply in peg units and USD, price and supply on chain if given. Without: every stablecoin's supply together (USD, USD pegs at par), overall or on chain. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

chain.description: A chain name as DefiLlama writes it, case-insensitive (Ethereum, Base, Tron).

days.description: Days of daily history, counting today.

stablecoin.description: A symbol (USDT), CoinGecko id (tether) or DefiLlama id; empty for all.

tools.name: treasury_companies
tools.description: Public companies holding crypto (BTC, ETH, SOL and others) on their balance sheet: market cap, NAV, mNAV and holdings per token, 50 per page. Totals cover every company, not just the page. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

tools.name: yield_pools
tools.description: DeFi yield and lending pools across protocols and chains, updated hourly: supply APY (base + reward), borrow APY for lending pools, TVL and what it counts, 50 per page. Filter by chain, token (symbol, name, address or pair), stablecoins only, a minimum TVL (use min_tvl_usd of 1000000 or more to skip thin pools, whose APYs swing), a minimum APY and held_only (yields that held over 30 days). apy_spike marks a supply APY over 3x its 30-day mean; sorted by supply_apy, highest first, those come last. A pool with tvl_kind collateral is a market taking the token as collateral: it pays nothing on it and lends collateral_for (when known) at borrow_apy_pct; for a token, those come after the pools that pay a yield. curated_by marks pools AlphaGrowth runs; it never changes the order. Each pool links to its page with the daily history; yield_pool returns that history. To borrow against a token, use borrow_markets. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

amount_usd.description: The USD value you would deposit: each pool then says what share of it that would be (a deposit over ~10% of a pool moves its APY).

chain.description: The chain: its slug or name (base, Ethereum, unichain, arbitrum, solana).

held_only.description: yes for pools whose APY held: a 30-day mean exists, the APY is at most twice it and at most 100% (spikes and new pools left out).

min_apy.description: The smallest supply APY in percent a pool needs to be listed.

min_tvl_usd.description: The smallest TVL in USD a pool needs to be listed.

sort_order.description: desc for the highest first, asc for the lowest.

token.description: A token: symbol (WETH), name (Ondo Finance), contract address, or a pair (cbBTC-WETH). Matches the token's own pools first, then pools holding it with others; ETH also matches WETH, BTC the wrapped bitcoins.

tools.name: yield_pool
tools.description: One DeFi yield pool by id (as listed by yield_pools): latest supply and borrow APYs, TVL, its daily APY and TVL history over the last `days` days, and up to five larger pools of the same token on other protocols or chains. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

days.description: How many days of daily history, the latest last.

id.description: The pool id (a UUID), as yield_pools lists it.

tools.name: borrow_markets
tools.description: Where a holder can borrow against a token: every lending market that takes it as collateral (Euler vaults, Morpho markets, Aave, Spark, Venus and other pooled lenders), with the LTV (the most you can borrow, in % of the collateral), the liquidation LTV, the borrow APY and what the market can lend now. Give amount_usd, the USD value of the tokens to post, to see what that position could borrow in each market and split across markets, so a position larger than the markets can absorb is answered honestly. Ranked by what can be borrowed, then the rate. Updated hourly; market data, not a quote. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

amount_usd.description: The USD value of the tokens to post, to size what they could borrow.

borrow.description: What to borrow: stablecoins, or a token symbol (DAI, WETH). Leave out for anything.

chain.description: Only markets on this chain: its slug or name (base, Ethereum, unichain).

token.description: The token to post as collateral: a symbol (ONDO), a name (Ondo Finance), a project slug or a contract address.

tools.name: token_unlocks
tools.description: Upcoming token unlocks from the tokens' emissions schedules, updated daily: per token and unlock moment, the cliff tokens released, the net change of linear vesting (tokens a week), the allocations (team, investors, airdrop, ...), the value in USD at the token's latest price and the share of its circulating supply, 50 per page. Filter by days ahead, allocation category, a minimum USD value or one token; sort by date or value. Schedules are taken as published; a team's 'unlock' may vest per person rather than reach the market at once. Each unlock carries the date of its price and of its schedule. One above 1,000% of the circulating supply is implausible and has no value or share; by value, it and those with a price over 2 days or a schedule over 3 days old come after the rest. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

category.description: Only the allocations of this category (insiders = team and advisors, privateSale = investors).

days.description: How many days ahead, from now.

min_value_usd.description: The smallest unlock value in USD to list (unlocks of tokens without a price drop out above 0).

sort_by.description: date for the soonest first, value for the largest first.

token.description: One token: its AlphaGrowth project slug (find_projects gives it).

tools.name: grants
tools.description: Open crypto and Web3 funding opportunities builders can still apply to — grant programs, hackathons, bug bounties, accelerators, RFPs — updated daily, 50 per page: name, summary, amount as announced (and in USD when stated in dollars), deadline and the announcement's link. Search names and summaries with query (e.g. a chain or ecosystem); sort by deadline, amount or name. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

query.description: Only opportunities whose name or summary contains this text.

sort_by.description: deadline (soonest first), amount (largest USD first) or name; by default dated ones soonest first, then undated ones newest first.

tools.name: spaces
tools.description: Recorded and transcribed crypto X (Twitter) Spaces and broadcasts, newest first, 50 per page: title, date, duration, an AI summary and who spoke. Search titles and summaries with query; read a recording's transcript and Q&A with space. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

query.description: Only recordings whose title or summary contains this text.

tools.name: space
tools.description: One transcribed crypto X (Twitter) Space by slug (as listed by spaces): its AI summary, hosts and speakers with the projects they spoke for, the questions and answers drawn from it, and its timestamped transcript, 200 snippets per transcript_page. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

slug.description: The recording's slug, as spaces lists it.

transcript_page.description: Page of the transcript, 200 snippets per page.

tools.name: dao_treasuries
tools.description: Lists DAO treasuries worth more than $500, largest first: total USD value, 24h change, category, top tokens and main chain. Use the links for a DAO's daily history. Each treasury carries its as_of date; one not updated in 2 days is listed after the current ones. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

project.description: Only this DAO: its name, its project's slug or name (e.g. uniswap — the Uniswap DAO, whose project is uniswap-labs).

tools.name: dao_treasury_snapshot
tools.description: Every listed DAO's treasury value in USD as of one UTC day (the last sample up to 6 days before it), largest first, for any day since 2024-07-24 up to yesterday (default: yesterday). Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD, from 2024-07-24 to yesterday (default: yesterday, UTC).

tools.name: dao_treasury_history
tools.description: Daily total treasury value in USD of one DAO, one point per UTC day (the day's last sample), daily since 2024-07-24; defaults to the whole history. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

dao.description: The DAO's id as listed by dao_treasuries, or its name or project slug (e.g. 2, uniswap).

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD (default: first day with data).

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, not after today (default: latest).

tools.name: dao_holdings_history
tools.description: Daily token holdings of one DAO treasury (amount, USD value and price per token, one point per token per UTC day), daily since 2024-07-24. At most 92 days per call, the last 30 days by default. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

dao.description: The DAO's id as listed by dao_treasuries, or its name or project slug (e.g. 2, uniswap).

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, not after today (default: today, UTC).

tools.name: dao_treasury
tools.description: One DAO treasury by id or name: total USD value, 24h change, category, top tokens and main chain. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

id.description: The DAO's id as listed by dao_treasuries, or its name or project slug (e.g. 2, uniswap).
